units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 31:25">Targ. Jer. XXXI, 25</cite> <he>הֲנַתְנִי</he> ed. Lag. (oth. ed. <he>הֲנָאַתְנִי</he>).
Targ. Is. XLIV, 10 לַהֲנָאָה (h. text הוֹעִיל); a. e.—Part. הָנֵי.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:1">Gen. R. s. 8</cite> <he>עביד מה דה׳ לך</he> do what pleases thee.—Pl. <he>הַנְיָין</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 3:2">Gen. R. s. 3</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 9:2">s. 9</cite> <he>דין ה׳ לי יתהון לא ה׳ לי</he> these (worlds) please me, those did not &c.; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 34:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXIV</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:11:1">Koh. R. to III, 11</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00918"><he>דֵּן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 99b:19">Snh. 99ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מאי אַהֲנוּ לן רבנן</he> (not <cite ref="E00676"><he>אהני</he></cite>) what good have the Rabbis done us? <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 14b:8">Ab. Zar. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>אַהֲנָאִי לכון וכ׳</he> I did you good inasmuch &c. Y. Ber. I, 4ᵇ bot. <he>ומה מְהַנְיָא ליה</he> (ed. Krot. <he>ומה</he> missing) what good will it do him?; Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᶜ bot. <he>ומה אנים ליה</he> (corr. acc.); a. fr.
<cite ref="Temurah 4b:32">Tem. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>אי עביד מַהֲנֵי</he> if (what the law forbids) has been done, the act has its legal effect.
<cite ref="Berakhot 43a:8">Ber. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>מְהַנְיָא ליה הסבה</he> the lying down of a company for a meal has an influence (in that one says the benediction in behalf of all); a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 1:6">Targ. Y. Deut. I, 6</cite> <he>א׳ לכון</he> it benefitted you (v.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 17:16">Targ. II Sam. XVII, 16</cite> <he>דלמא יִתְהֲנִי וכ׳</he> (ed. Wil. <he>יִתַּהֲנִי</he>) perhaps it will please the king (h. text <he>יְבֻלַּע</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 16:31">Targ. Ez. XVI, 31</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Nedarim 50a:1">Ned. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>דאִיתְהֲנִי וכ׳</he> that I should enjoy this world’s goods.
<cite ref="Chagigah 15a:7">Ḥag. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>לִיתְהֲנֵי וכ׳</he> let him (myself) enjoy the world.

<cite ref="Yevamot 103a:17">Yeb. 103ᵃ</cite> <he>מִתְהַנְיָא מעבירה</he> she derived gratification from a sinful act. Y. Snh. X, 29ᵇ top <he>ובר נש לא מִתְהֲנֵי כלום</he> (not <he>מתהנים</he>) and none were benefitted; a. fr.
